name: Landlord Watch
kicker: Plot Yangu feature · WhatsApp and web
seoTitle: Landlord Watch: See Agent-Managed Rent | SAMUHIA
description: Landlord Watch shows landlords with agent-managed properties what rent was collected, what is pending and what is payable, on WhatsApp or the web.
cardDescription: A read-only view of rent collection, commission and net payable for landlords whose properties are managed by an agency.
title: Landlord Watch
lead: If an agency manages your property, you should not have to chase a phone call to find out whether rent came in. Landlord Watch gives you a read-only view of your property's rent collection, on WhatsApp or the web, in English or Kiswahili.
audience: Landlords whose properties are managed by an agency or property manager, and the agencies that manage them
ctaSecondaryLabel: Talk to us about Landlord Watch
problem: When a landlord hands a property to an agency, the numbers often arrive once a month, if at all. The landlord waits to learn what was collected, what is outstanding and what they will be paid, and the agency answers the same questions again and again.
capabilities: Occupancy: active tenants, occupied units and vacant units
The month's invoices at a glance: paid, part-paid and unpaid
Rent billed, collected and still pending, with a collection rate
The agent's commission and the net amount payable to the landlord
How much was collected by the due date and how much after it
Who has paid and who has not, unit by unit
A month-by-month trend, and any earlier month on request
The monthly statement: income, deductions and net payable
An official monthly statement as a PDF
steps: Your agent manages the property in Plot Yangu and gives you the property's ID.

Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473 and choose Landlord Watch from the menu (or type WATCH), or use the Landlord Watch button on the Plot Yangu sign-in screen. Then enter the property ID.
See the property summary straight away. Tenant names and phone numbers stay hidden until you unlock them.
To unlock details, ask for a one-time code. It is sent by SMS to the owner phone number on file for the property.
Browse the tenants list, the money breakdown and earlier months, and request the monthly statement PDF.

safeguards.title: Privacy and control
items: Landlord Watch is for viewing. It does not change invoices, payments or tenant records.
Tenant names and phone numbers are hidden by default.
Details unlock with a one-time SMS code sent to the owner phone on file, and the unlock is temporary.
Signing in on the web with the phone number registered as the property owner's unlocks details without a separate code.
If no owner phone number is on file, details stay hidden until the agent adds one.

audiences.title: Why agencies offer Landlord Watch
audiences.lead: Landlord Watch works from the records you already keep in Plot Yangu. You stay the system of record, and your landlords get a clear window onto their own property.
items: Answers the landlord's routine question, "has the rent come in?", before they have to ask it.
Landlords see figures drawn from your Plot Yangu records, so month-end conversations are about the numbers rather than whether they exist.
Tenant names and phone numbers are protected by default, so you can offer transparency without handing over your tenant list.
Landlords can check at any time on WhatsApp, the channel they already use.
A visible, professional reporting service helps you win new landlords and keep the ones you have.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: WhatsApp and the Plot Yangu web app

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Read-only; one-time SMS code unlocks tenant details

faq.q: What is Landlord Watch?
faq.a: Landlord Watch is a Plot Yangu feature that lets a landlord whose property is managed by an agency see how the property is performing: rent billed, collected and pending, the agent's commission, the net amount payable and who has paid. It is available on WhatsApp and on the web, in English and Kiswahili.

faq.q: What is the WhatsApp number for Landlord Watch?
faq.a: Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, then choose Landlord Watch from the menu or type WATCH. You can pick English or Kiswahili.

faq.q: Can a landlord change anything in Landlord Watch?
faq.a: No. Landlord Watch is read-only. The agency keeps managing invoices, payments and tenants in Plot Yangu.

faq.q: Can landlords see tenant names and phone numbers?
faq.a: Only after they unlock them. Tenant details are hidden by default, and a landlord unlocks them with a one-time code sent by SMS to the owner phone number on file.

faq.q: How does a landlord get access?
faq.a: Ask your agent for your property's ID in Plot Yangu, then open Landlord Watch on WhatsApp or the web and enter it.

faq.q: Does my agency need Plot Yangu?
faq.a: Yes. Landlord Watch shows properties that your agency manages in Plot Yangu. Agencies can start on the Plot Yangu product page.

faq.q: Can I get a monthly statement?
faq.a: Yes. You can request an official monthly statement as a PDF. If a fee applies, the price is shown and you pay by M-Pesa before the statement is generated.

botText: Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, choose Landlord Watch from the menu or type WATCH, and enter your property ID.

name: House to Rent
seoTitle: House to Rent / House to Let on WhatsApp | SAMUHIA
description: Find a house to rent or let by area on WhatsApp, see rent and deposit, and send an inquiry to the property manager by SMS. In English and Kiswahili.
cardDescription: Search vacant units by area on WhatsApp and send an inquiry straight to the property manager.
title: House to Rent
lead: Looking for a house to let in Kenya usually means calling around. House to Rent lets people type an area on WhatsApp, browse vacant units with their rent and deposit, and send an inquiry straight to the property manager.
audience: People looking for a house, room, shop or office to rent, and property managers and landlords with vacant units
ctaSecondaryLabel: Talk to us about listing your units
problem: Every vacant unit is rent that is not being earned, and a unit nobody knows about stays vacant. House hunters, on the other hand, spend days phoning agents and visiting buildings that turn out to be full.
capabilitiesTitle: What a house hunter can do
capabilities: Search by area, for example Naivasha or Mirera, in English or Kiswahili
Browse vacant units: single rooms, bedsitters, studios, one, two and three bedrooms, maisonettes, shops, offices, stalls and warehouses
See the property name, address, type, condition, monthly rent and deposit
View the property manager's contact details
Send an inquiry by SMS to the manager from inside WhatsApp, after confirming the message and the phone number to call back
steps: A property manager or landlord keeps units in Plot Yangu and marks the empty ones as vacant.
For properties synced to the cloud, vacant unit details are listed automatically. Nothing extra to post.
A house hunter messages the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, chooses House to Rent from the menu and types the area they want.
They pick a unit from the matches and see its rent, deposit and details.
They contact the manager, or confirm their phone number and send an inquiry. The manager receives it by SMS and calls back.

safeguards.title: Built to protect landlords and tenants
items: Only unit facts are shown: size, type, condition, rent and deposit. Tenant records and the landlord's personal details are never listed.
A unit disappears from the list as soon as it is no longer marked vacant.
Inquiries are limited per person each day, and a repeat inquiry for the same unit is blocked, so managers are not flooded.
The house hunter sees exactly what will be sent and confirms it before anything goes out.

audiences.title: Why property managers and landlords list here
audiences.lead: House to Rent turns the units you already track in Plot Yangu into leads, on the channel people already use.
items: No separate listing to write or keep up to date. Your vacancies come from your Plot Yangu records.
Reach people searching by area on WhatsApp, in English or Kiswahili.
Inquiries arrive by SMS with the person's number, ready for a call back.
Works for homes and for commercial space such as shops, offices, stalls and warehouses.
Pairs with Landlord Watch: landlords see the vacancies and the rent, and agents fill the units.

facts.label: Contact
facts.value: Manager's details or an SMS inquiry

faq.q: How do I find a house to rent on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Open the SAMUHIA WhatsApp menu, choose House to Rent and type the area you want to live in. You will see the vacant units listed there, with rent and deposit, and can open any one for details.

faq.q: What is the WhatsApp number for House to Rent?
faq.a: Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, then choose House to Rent from the menu and type the area you are looking in. You can pick English or Kiswahili.

faq.q: What details do I see for each unit?
faq.a: The unit size and number, the property name, the address, whether it is residential or commercial, its condition, the monthly rent and the deposit.

faq.q: Can I search for shops and offices as well as houses?
faq.a: Yes. Listings include shops, offices, stalls and warehouses alongside single rooms, bedsitters, studios, bedroom units and maisonettes.

faq.q: How does my inquiry reach the property manager?
faq.a: You confirm your phone number and the message, and it is sent to the manager by SMS. The manager then contacts you. You can also use the manager's contact details directly.

faq.q: How do I list my vacant units?
faq.a: Manage the property in Plot Yangu with cloud sync and mark empty units as vacant. They are listed automatically, and they leave the list when they are no longer vacant.

faq.q: Are tenant details shown in listings?
faq.a: No. Listings show unit facts only. Tenant records and the landlord's personal details are never part of a listing.

botTitle: Use House to Rent on WhatsApp
botText: Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, choose House to Rent from the menu and type the area you want.

name: Lipa Mos Mos
kicker: Plot Yangu feature · WhatsApp and web
seoTitle: Lipa Mos Mos: Pay Rent Little by Little | SAMUHIA
description: Pay your rent a little at a time with Lipa Mos Mos. Pay daily, weekly or every two weeks by M-Pesa on WhatsApp or the web. Your landlord is paid once it adds up.
cardDescription: Pay rent in small instalments, daily, weekly or every two weeks, and your landlord is paid once it adds up.
title: Lipa Mos Mos
lead: Rent day is hard when the full amount has to arrive all at once. Lipa Mos Mos lets tenants pay rent in small instalments that fit how they earn, and see exactly how far they have come. Landlords and agents are paid once the rent adds up.
audience: Tenants who earn daily or weekly, and landlords and agents who want rent to arrive on time
ctaSecondaryLabel: Talk to us about Lipa Mos Mos
problem: Many tenants are paid daily or weekly, but rent is due once a month. That gap leads to late payments, awkward reminders and landlords who spend their time chasing. Lipa Mos Mos matches rent to the way people actually earn.
capabilities: Pay rent a little at a time: daily, weekly or every two weeks
Choose how much to pay each time, from a small amount upwards
Pay by M-Pesa prompt from WhatsApp or the Samuhia Payments web app
See progress at a glance: what is paid, what is left and when the landlord is paid
Get short, friendly SMS updates on progress and when the landlord has been paid
Use it in English or Kiswahili on WhatsApp
steps: The landlord or agent turns on Lipa Mos Mos for their payout account in Samuhia Payments.
The tenant chooses Pay Rent on WhatsApp or opens the Samuhia Payments web app, finds their rent and picks Lipa Mos Mos.
They choose how often to pay and how much each time. The total is shown before they confirm.
Each payment is added to the rent balance and the progress bar moves up.
When the rent is covered, or on the monthly settlement date, the landlord is paid and the invoice is updated. A part-payment shows as partial, so the record is always honest.

safeguards.title: Clear, fair and protected
items: Tenants see what they will be charged before they pay, and the rent is credited with exactly the amount they chose.
Every payment is checked before it counts towards the rent.
Landlords and agents are paid only to their own verified payout account.
Invoices show part-payments as partial, so nobody is told rent is settled when it is not.
Reminders are friendly and infrequent, never a flood.

audiences.title: Why landlords and agents offer Lipa Mos Mos
audiences.lead: Rent that arrives in small steps is rent that arrives.
items: Fewer late payments and fewer difficult conversations
Tenants who earn daily or weekly can pay without waiting for a lump sum
Invoices update automatically, including part-payments
No change to how you manage your property in Plot Yangu
Pairs with Landlord Watch, so landlords can follow rent as it comes in

facts.label: Where
facts.value: WhatsApp and the Samuhia Payments web app

facts.label: Pay
facts.value: Daily, weekly or every two weeks

facts.label: Landlord is paid
facts.value: When the rent is covered, or on the monthly settlement date

faq.q: What is Lipa Mos Mos?
faq.a: Lipa Mos Mos is a SAMUHIA feature that lets tenants pay their rent a little at a time, daily, weekly or every two weeks. Each payment is added to the rent balance, and the landlord or agent is paid once the rent is covered.

faq.q: Can I pay my rent in instalments in Kenya?
faq.a: Yes, if your landlord or agent has Lipa Mos Mos switched on. You pay by M-Pesa in small amounts that suit you, and you can see your progress until the rent is covered.

faq.q: How do I pay rent little by little on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, choose Pay Rent, find your tenant record and pick Lipa Mos Mos. Choose how often you want to pay, enter an amount and approve the M-Pesa prompt.

faq.q: How often can I pay?
faq.a: You can choose daily, weekly or every two weeks. You decide how much to pay each time, and you can pay more or less than the suggestion.

faq.q: Does Lipa Mos Mos cost extra?
faq.a: A small service fee is added to each payment. You see the total before you confirm, and your rent is credited with exactly the amount you chose.

faq.q: When does my landlord get paid?
faq.a: Your landlord or agent is paid when your rent is covered, or on the monthly settlement date, the 5th, with what you have paid so far. If the rent is not fully paid by then, the invoice shows as partially paid and your balance stays on your plan.

faq.q: What happens if I miss a payment?
faq.a: You get a short, friendly SMS reminder. Your landlord's own tenancy terms still apply, so it is best to keep paying a little each time.

faq.q: Is my money safe?
faq.a: Each payment is checked before it counts towards your rent, and landlords are paid only to their own verified payout account. You always see what you are about to pay before you confirm.

faq.q: How can a landlord or agent offer Lipa Mos Mos?
faq.a: Set up your payout account in Samuhia Payments and switch on Lipa Mos Mos. It works with M-Pesa, Till and bank payout accounts, and you keep managing your property in Plot Yangu as usual.

faq.q: Is Lipa Mos Mos available in Kiswahili?
faq.a: Yes. On WhatsApp you can choose English or Kiswahili, and the reminders and updates use simple, polite language in both.
